page_title: FIO 0-0 VEN | Fiorentina v Venezia 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 777' A substitution has been made. Amir Richardson goes off and Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) comes on.
90+6' Simone Sozza is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.

89' What an opportunity! Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
87' Here comes a substitution. Mikael Egill Ellertsson is given a rest as he is replaced by Issa Doumbia (Venezia).
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Venezia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Venezia.
82' Antonio Candela (Venezia) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
82' The current number of corner kicks is 5:2.
79' Substitution. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Moise Kean walks off.
77' Here is a change. Pietro Comuzzo is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina).
77' Nicholas Pierini (Venezia) sends a chip pass into the box, but Pietro Terracciano is quickest to intercept the ball.
75' Fiorentina hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
72' The referee blows for a cooling break.
71' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

71' A lofted cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

69' This was a piece of cake for Pietro Terracciano. Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
68' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Jay Idzes and he is replaced by Michael Svoboda (Venezia).
67' A substitution has been made. Magnus Kofod Andersen is replaced by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia).
67' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) replacing Christian Kouame.

66' That was a nice football moment. Francesco Zampano (Venezia) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top right corner. Pietro Terracciano guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
64' Venezia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' A cross from Antonio Candela (Venezia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Venezia.
63' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) strikes the ball on goal from the resulting free kick, but his effort goes wide.
61' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Francesco Zampano (Venezia) for his blatant foul.
59' The goalkeeper makes a nice save to avert the danger from the free kick, which was executed by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina).
57' A cross from a corner kick by Fiorentina is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

57' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Fiorentina force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
55' It will be a substitution. Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is ready to enter the pitch as Antonin Barak walks off.
54' Some great controlled play and passing from Fiorentina. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

50' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the bottom right corner, but Jesse Joronen reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
49' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco has made a change at the break. Antonio Raimondo has come on in place of Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
46' The game is over for Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia). Nicholas Pierini comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Jesse Joronen comes off his line to gather the ball.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
43' Dodo (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Fiorentina get a corner.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
42' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Fiorentina can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

39' What an amazing save by Jesse Joronen! Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the left side of the target, but fails. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
38' Flag goes up against Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
37' Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
34' The total number of attempts is 4:4.
33' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

31' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Jesse Joronen pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going under the crossbar.
29' Giorgio Altare (Venezia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
26' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
21' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
20' Venezia players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
19' Venezia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

18' Antonio Candela (Venezia) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Venezia are awarded a corner kick.
17' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
15' Dodo (Fiorentina) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.

14' A long pass finds Moise Kean (Fiorentina) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
11' Antonio Candela (Venezia) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
9' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) looks to pass after collecting a rebound, but a lack of options forces him to shoot from distance and it's easily blocked by an opponent.
7' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
5' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Jesse Joronen punches the ball away.
2' Some neat passing and movement from Fiorentina as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simone Sozza.
